title: terminal.open — open a PTY session; this command stays running and streams `output` events (data = base64 of raw PTY bytes, stream=stdout) until closed/idle/timeout

cwd.description: a cwd that doesn't exist starts in the user's home (terminal.v2 agents print `falak: <cwd> does not exist; starting in <home>` first)

relay_token.description: terminal.v2: the agent also pipes the session through the terminal relay: it dials wss://<agent API base>/relay/sessions/<session_id> with this bearer token (HTTP/1.1, its client certificate); PTY output goes out as binary frames as well as `output` events, binary frames in are keystrokes, text {t:resize} resizes, {t:exit,reason,code} ends it. Retried while the session lives; never fails the session

container.description: terminal.v2: a shell in a container instead of on the host (`docker exec -it -e TERM=xterm-256color [-e env…] [-u user] [-w workdir] <container> sh -c <bash or sh>`, as root); user, shell and cwd don't apply, env is passed with -e. Fails with "No running container for this console (is the site deployed?)" when nothing matches

name.description: the container (must exist and run), e.g. falak-db-<id>

labels.description: the newest running container carrying all of them, e.g. {"falak.site": "shop"} or the compose project and service labels
